page.title: Life Memory
page.subtitle: Search your professional knowledge and client history securely, from one place.

search.professionalPlaceholder: Search: stone, protocol, symbol, chakra, topic…
search.clientPlaceholder: Search: client history, session note, assignment, stone, topic…

client.intro: Search the past records of your own clients (sessions, notes, assignments, stones, combinations, appointments). Only clients within your own account scope are shown.
client.sourceGone: The source record no longer exists (snapshot preserved).

notActive.title: Client Memory is not active yet
notActive.msg: Once this feature is enabled, you can search your client history.

flagDisabled.title: Life Memory is not active on this account yet
flagDisabled.msg: You can search once this feature is enabled for your account.

demo.title: Unavailable on demo accounts
demo.msg: Client memory search is not available on demo accounts.

coldStart.title: Start searching
coldStart.msg: Type a stone, protocol, symbol, chakra or topic; we will search your professional knowledge pool.

clientColdStart.title: Start searching
clientColdStart.msg: Search your client history for sessions, notes, assignments, stones, combinations or appointments.

noResults.title: No results found
noResults.msg: No records were found for this search. Try a different word.

filtered.title: No results in the selected module
filtered.msg: There are results, but not in the modules you selected. Broaden the filter.

indexEmpty.title: Your professional memory is being prepared…
indexEmpty.msg: Your records are being transferred to professional memory. Searches may return no results in the meantime; once the transfer is complete, your records will be searchable here.

indexReadyEmpty.title: Your professional memory is ready
indexReadyEmpty.msg: There are no searchable records yet. As you create records in the modules, your content will become searchable here.

outOfScope.title: This account is outside the professional index scope
outOfScope.msg: This account’s library records are not added to professional memory (a deliberate scope decision). You can use the Client Memory tab.

disabled.title: Life Memory is not active on this account yet
disabled.msg: You can search once this feature is enabled for your account.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.msg: The search could not be completed. Please try again.
